diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~16% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.029), which favours a robust combination.
